nodes.description: Owner address stored in BotProtected; set to tx.origin in Shibooster constructor and used as the sole access-control gate for privileged functions.
External address of the Ferrum bot-protection contract called via low-level call in the checkBots modifier and in distribute/list.
Computed Uniswap/Pancake pair address used by the bot protection call; derived in the constructor via pairOf.
Public mapping of token balances, written with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and arbitrarily overwritten in distribute/list.
Public nested mapping of allowances; the constructor grants uint(-1) approvals to the router and to tx.origin for the pair.
Total token supply (1e29), used in list to mint 6% of supply to the caller.
Hard-coded IUniswapV2Router02 instance used by list to add liquidity with ETH.
Hard-coded WETH address used in the constructor to compute the pair address.
Modifier that performs a low-level external call to botProtection (selector 0x15274141) and requires the returned flag before executing the body.
Constructor of Shibooster: sets owner = tx.origin, computes uniPair, and grants unlimited allowances.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core transfer logic with checkBots modifier; external call executes before balance state updates and balances are changed with raw arithmetic.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no checks.
Owner-only function executing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata, allowing full storage takeover.
Internal pure function computing the deterministic pair address via keccak256 of the factory, tokens and init code hash.
Owner-only airdrop that makes an unchecked external call to botProtection and then arbitrarily overwrites recipients' balances without increasing totalSupply.
Owner-only listing function that mints 6% of totalSupply to the caller, adds ETH liquidity via the router using block.timestamp as deadline, and performs an unchecked external botProtection call.
Caller-controlled address used for allowances, ownership checks and transfers.
Transaction origin used to set the owner and unlimited pair allowance, making ownership vulnerable to phishing.
Used in list to construct the router deadline (block.timestamp + 600), making liquidity timing miner-influenceable.
Low-level external call to botProtection inside the checkBots modifier, executed before state updates and enabling reentrancy.
delegatecall in delegate() to an arbitrary attacker-supplied address and calldata.
External payable call to pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH in list with a timestamp-derived deadline.
Unchecked low-level call to botProtection in distribute; return value ignored and invoked before balance writes.
Unchecked low-level call to botProtection in list; return value ignored and executed after liquidity addition.
Unchecked raw subtraction/addition of balanceOf in transferFrom without SafeMath (relies on >= require for underflow).
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, used in allowance and balance arithmetic.
Target address parameter of delegate, used as delegatecall destination.
Calldata parameter of delegate, passed to delegatecall.
Array of recipient addresses in distribute.
Amount assigned to every recipient in distribute.
Amount used in list to set the contract balance and token liquidity.
Array of amounts assigned to recipients in list.
Local boolean returned by the botProtection low-level call in checkBots.
Local boolean returned by the delegatecall in delegate.
Loop index used in distribute and list airdrop loops.
Constructor parameter carrying the bot-protection contract address.
Constructor of BotProtected that stores the botProtection address.

edges.reason: Shibooster constructor assigns the owner state variable.
owner is initialized from tx.origin, so a phishing intermediary can become the owner.
Constructor computes and stores uniPair.
pairOf return value is written into uniPair.
Constructor writes unlimited allowances into the allowance mapping.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the _from argument and as the spender in the allowance check.
transferFrom runs the checkBots modifier before its body.
The checkBots modifier makes an external call to botProtection.
The external botProtection call completes before any balance state is updated, allowing reentrancy.
The botProtection state variable provides the call target.
The boolean returned by the low-level call is stored in the notABot local.
The _value parameter drives allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is computed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is computed without overflow protection.
transferFrom performs raw unchecked balance arithmetic.
approve sets allowance on behalf of msg.sender without validation.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner, an owner value derived from tx.origin.
delegate executes a delegatecall.
Parameter a supplies the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b supplies the delegatecall calldata.
The delegatecall success flag is stored in the success local.
distribute requires msg.sender == owner before overwriting balances.
distribute makes an unchecked external call to botProtection before writing balances.
The botProtection address is the target of the unchecked call in distribute.
distribute overwrites balanceOf for every address in _toWho.
distribute loops over recipients using index i.
list requires msg.sender == owner before minting and listing.
list invokes pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH.
list uses block.timestamp to build the router deadline.
The liquidity deadline is block.timestamp + 600, making it miner-influenceable.
list performs an unchecked external call to botProtection after liquidity addition.
The botProtection address is the target of the unchecked call in list.
list mints 6% of totalSupply to the caller.
_numList sets balanceOf[address(this)] before adding liquidity.
_amounts overwrite recipient balances in list.
BotProtected constructor stores the botProtection address.
The _botProtection parameter is written to the botProtection state variable.
transfer uses msg.sender as the sending address.
list loops over recipients using index i.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is an input parameter consumed only by transferFrom.
_to is an input parameter consumed only by transferFrom.
_value is an input parameter driving transferFrom arithmetic.
a is the delegatecall target parameter of delegate.
b is the delegatecall calldata parameter of delegate.
_toWho is the recipient array parameter of distribute.
amount is the value parameter written into balances by distribute.
_numList is the liquidity/balance parameter of list.
_amounts is the recipient amount array parameter of list.
notABot holds the return flag of the low-level botProtection call in checkBots.
success holds the return flag of the delegatecall in delegate.
i is the local loop counter of the distribute airdrop loop.
_botProtection is the constructor parameter stored as the botProtection address.
